completion:

   a. Test the factor and then enter results in the tables.
   b. Record the failures in a log. Any failed factor results may have varied causes, for example:
      i. the failure might be unrelated to the fire-safety checks on the building.
      ii. the failure might be due to poor standards of supervision during construction.

      i. Programme A and B are chosen rectification programmes to address failure caused by poor standards of supervision.
